defmodule ProCoder.Brain.Client.Engine do
  @moduledoc """
  The primary orchestration hub for LLM-related IO operations.
  Bridges high-level gen_statem interactions with low-level HTTP/2 streaming via Finch.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  alias ProCoder.Brain.Client.HTTPPool.Manager, as: HTTPPool
  alias ProCoder.Brain.Client.SSEParser
  alias ProCoder.Brain.RateLimiter

  @type state :: %{
    pool_name: atom() | nil,
    caller: pid() | nil,
    parser: pid() | nil,
    stream_ref: reference() | nil
  }

  @doc """
  Starts the Engine.
  """
  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @doc """
  Initiates a streaming request.
  """
  def stream(caller, context, opts) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:stream, caller, context, opts})
  end

  @doc """
  Performs a synchronous chat request.
  """
  def chat(context, opts) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:chat, context, opts})
  end

  @impl true
  def init(_opts) do
    {:ok, %{pool_name: nil, caller: nil, parser: nil, stream_ref: nil}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:stream, caller, context, opts}, _from, state) do
    case RateLimiter.consume(1) do
      :ok ->
        case prepare_request(opts) do
          {:ok, pool_name} ->
            {:ok, parser_pid} = SSEParser.start_link(caller: caller, config: [])
            
            # Initiate Finch stream
            # Note: Implementation detail assumes Finch is used via the pool manager
            ref = make_ref()
            {:reply, {:ok, ref}, %{state | pool_name: pool_name, caller: caller, parser: parser_pid, stream_ref: ref}}
          
          error ->
            {:reply, error, state}
        end
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:chat, context, opts}, _from, state) do
    case RateLimiter.consume(1) do
      :ok ->
        case prepare_request(opts) do
          {:ok, pool_name} ->
            # Perform synchronous request
            case perform_sync_request(pool_name, context, opts) do
              {:ok, response} -> {:reply, {:ok, response}, state}
              {:error, reason} -> {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
            end
          error ->
            {:reply, error, state}
        end
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  defp prepare_request(_opts) do
    endpoint_id = "llm_provider"
    HTTPPool.checkout(endpoint_id)
  end

  defp perform_sync_request(_pool, _context, _opts) do
    # Placeholder for actual Finch.request implementation logic
    # In a real system, this would involve building the request struct
    # and executing it through the Finch pool.
    {:ok, %ProCoder.Core.Types.Message{role: :assistant, content: "Mock response"}}
  end
end

defmodule ProCoder.Brain.Client.LLMClientIntegrationTest do
  @moduledoc """
  Integration test suite for the ProCoder Brain LLM Client.
  
  This suite validates the full lifecycle of synchronous chat and asynchronous streaming
  interactions, testing fault-tolerance, rate limiting, and SSE parsing robustness.
  """

  use ExUnit.Case, async: false

  alias ProCoder.Brain.Client.Engine
  alias ProCoder.Brain.Client.HTTPPool.Manager, as: HTTPPool
  alias ProCoder.Brain.RateLimiter
  alias ProCoder.Core.Types.Message

  @moduletag :integration

  setup_all do
    # Ensure dependencies are running
    start_supervised!(HTTPPool)
    start_supervised!(RateLimiter)
    start_supervised!(Engine)
    :ok
  end

  describe "Synchronous Chat Cycle" do
    test "successfully executes a blocking chat request" do
      context = [%Message{role: :user, content: "Hello, ProCoder"}]
      opts = [pool_name: :default_pool, timeout: 5000]

      assert {:ok, %Message{role: :assistant}} = Engine.chat(context, opts)
    end

    test "handles 429 Rate Limited responses gracefully" do
      # Assuming RateLimiter is configured or mocked to simulate pressure
      context = [%Message{role: :user, content: "Request 1"}]
      
      # Fill rate limiter bucket
      for _ <- 1..50, do: RateLimiter.consume(1)
      
      # This should either wait or return an error depending on rate limiter state
      # Given the current implementation, it should eventually return or block
      assert {:ok, _} = Engine.chat(context, [])
    end
  end

  describe "Asynchronous Streaming Cycle" do
    test "initiates and receives stream tokens via SSE" do
      caller = self()
      context = [%Message{role: :user, content: "Stream test"}]
      opts = [pool_name: :default_pool]

      assert {:ok, ref} = Engine.stream(caller, context, opts)
      assert is_reference(ref)

      # Verify stream events
      assert_receive {:sse_message, %{}}, 5000
      assert_receive :sse_done, 5000
    end

    test "handles malformed SSE frames without leaking data" do
      caller = self()
      # Simulate streaming an invalid JSON chunk
      # We check that the SSEParser handles the error and sends an :sse_error message
      
      # In a real scenario, this involves sending chunks to the parser directly or 
      # triggering a specific malformed response from the mock server.
      # For now, we verify error propagation.
      
      context = [%Message{role: :user, content: "Bad data test"}]
      {:ok, _ref} = Engine.stream(caller, context, [])
      
      # Verify that we receive an error event rather than a crash
      receive do
        {:sse_error, reason} -> assert reason in [:malformed_json_frame, :buffer_overflow]
        _ -> :ok
      after
        5000 -> :ok
      end
    end
  end

  describe "Concurrency & Scaling" do
    test "handles massive concurrent requests" do
      num_processes = 100
      caller = self()
      context = [%Message{role: :user, content: "Bulk test"}]

      tasks = Enum.map(1..num_processes, fn _ ->
        Task.async(fn ->
          Engine.chat(context, [])
        end)
      end)

      results = Task.yield_many(tasks, 10_000)
      
      # Verify majority of requests succeed under stress
      success_count = Enum.count(results, fn {_, res} -> 
        case res do
          {:ok, {:ok, _}} -> true
          _ -> false
        end
      end)
      
      assert success_count > (num_processes * 0.8)
    end
  end

  describe "Security & Data Integrity" do
    test "ensures no sensitive data is leaked in error reports" do
      # Force an error with a sensitive payload
      # Verify redaction logs
      context = [%Message{role: :user, content: "PROCODER_LLM_API_KEY=super-secret"}]
      
      # Simulate an error response
      {:error, reason} = Engine.chat(context, [pool_name: :non_existent])
      
      assert is_atom(reason) or is_binary(reason)
      refute String.contains?(inspect(reason), "super-secret")
    end
  end
end

defmodule ProCoder.Brain.Client.Requirements do
  @moduledoc """
  Defines the dependency requirements and foundational data structures for the
  ProCoder LLM Client. This module provides the specification for streaming
  token handling, SSE parsing, and JSON ingestion, ensuring compatibility with
  the high-concurrency requirements of the BEAM-based architecture.
  """

  @doc """
  Returns the list of required external dependencies for the LLM Client.
  These dependencies are mandated by the system architecture to ensure
  robust HTTP/2 pooling, serialization, and stream processing.
  """
  def dependencies do
    [
      {:finch, "~> 0.17.0"},  # HTTP/2 connection pooling
      {:jason, "~> 1.4.0"},   # High-performance JSON serialization
      {:req, "~> 0.4.0"}     # Robust API orchestration
    ]
  end

  @doc """
  Defines the expected structure for incoming SSE frames.
  Each frame must be decoded into this structure before further processing
  by the gen_statem orchestration layer.
  """
  defstruct correlation_id: nil,
            event_type: :message,
            payload: %{},
            timestamp: nil

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
    correlation_id: String.t(),
    event_type: :message | :error | :done | :ping,
    payload: map(),
    timestamp: DateTime.t()
  }

  @doc """
  Hardened JSON decoding logic for SSE streams.
  Ensures that malformed LLM responses are rejected early to maintain
  the stability of the internal state machines.
  """
  def parse_frame(data) when is_binary(data) do
    case Jason.decode(data) do
      {:ok, decoded} -> {:ok, decoded}
      {:error, _} -> {:error, :malformed_json_frame}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Back-pressure control configuration for active stream processes.
  Ensures the system does not exceed defined resource limits when
  ingesting tokens from upstream providers.
  """
  def stream_config do
    [
      max_buffer_size: 10_000,
      read_timeout: 5_000,
      retry_attempts: 3
    ]
  end
end

defmodule ProCoder.Brain.Client.Telemetry.EventMonitor do
  @moduledoc """
  Telemetry event monitor for the ProCoder LLM client.

  This module handles the sanitization and dispatch of observability events
  originating from the client engine, SSE parser, and rate limiter.
  It adheres to security compliance by enforcing automated data redaction
  on all metadata maps before telemetry dispatch.
  """

  require Logger

  @doc """
  Dispatches an event to the telemetry bus after applying redaction rules.
  """
  @spec emit(event_name :: [atom()], measurements :: map(), metadata :: map()) :: :ok
  def emit(event_name, measurements, metadata) when is_list(event_name) do
    clean_metadata = redact_metadata(metadata)
    :telemetry.execute(event_name, measurements, clean_metadata)
  end

  # --- Data Redaction Logic ---

  @redaction_patterns [
    ~r/(?:AIza[0-9A-Za-z-_]{35})/,
    ~r/(?:sk-(?:live|test)_[a-zA-Z0-9]{32})/,
    ~r/(?:Bearer\s+[a-zA-Z0-9-._~+/]+)/,
    ~r/authorization=\S+/i
  ]

  @doc """
  Sanitizes metadata to ensure PII and credentials are removed.
  """
  def redact_metadata(metadata) when is_map(metadata) do
    Enum.reduce(metadata, %{}, fn {key, value}, acc ->
      case value do
        v when is_binary(v) ->
          Map.put(acc, key, apply_patterns(v))

        v when is_map(v) ->
          Map.put(acc, key, redact_metadata(v))

        v ->
          Map.put(acc, key, v)
      end
    end)
  end

  def redact_metadata(other), do: other

  defp apply_patterns(value) do
    Enum.reduce(@redaction_patterns, value, fn pattern, acc ->
      String.replace(acc, pattern, "REDACTED")
    end)
  end
end

defmodule ProCoder.Brain.Client.HTTPPool.Manager do
  @moduledoc """
  The ProCoder HTTP Connection Pool Manager.

  Acts as an OTP GenServer providing an interface for managing Finch HTTP/2 connection pools.
  It dynamically sizes pools based on system scheduler availability and provides
  telemetry-enabled resource acquisition.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @type pool_name :: atom()
  @type pool_opts :: [size: pos_integer(), count: pos_integer()]

  @doc """
  Starts the HTTP Pool Manager.
  """
  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @doc """
  Checks out a connection pool for a specific endpoint.
  Returns the pool name for use with Finch.
  """
  def checkout(endpoint_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:checkout, endpoint_id})
  end

  @doc """
  Exposes current pool metrics.
  """
  def stats do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :stats)
  end

  @doc """
  Updates configuration for pools at runtime.
  """
  def update_config(new_opts) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:update_config, new_opts})
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    # Initial setup based on system config or defaults
    config = Application.get_env(:procoder, ProCoder.Brain.Client) || []
    pool_size = Keyword.get(config, :pool_size, System.schedulers_online() * 2)
    max_overflow = Keyword.get(config, :max_overflow, 5)

    state = %{
      pools: %{},
      config: %{pool_size: pool_size, max_overflow: max_overflow}
    }

    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:checkout, endpoint_id}, _from, state) do
    pool_name = :"finch_pool_#{endpoint_id}"

    case ensure_pool_started(pool_name, state.config) do
      {:ok, _} ->
        {:reply, {:ok, pool_name}, state}

      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Failed to acquire pool for #{endpoint_id}: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:reply, {:error, :service_unavailable}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:stats, _from, state) do
    # Aggregate stats from all managed pools
    stats = Enum.map(state.pools, fn {name, _} -> 
      {name, Finch.pool_stats(name)}
    end)
    {:reply, {:ok, stats}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:update_config, new_opts}, state) do
    new_config = Map.merge(state.config, Enum.into(new_opts, %{}))
    {:noreply, %{state | config: new_config}}
  end

  # Internal Helpers
  defp ensure_pool_started(name, config) do
    # Use Finch.start_pool explicitly if the pool doesn't exist
    case Process.whereis(name) do
      nil ->
        Finch.start_pool(name, 
          size: config.pool_size, 
          count: config.max_overflow
        )
      pid when is_pid(pid) ->
        {:ok, pid}
    end
  end
end

defmodule ProCoder.Brain.Client.Adapters.ProviderAdapter do
  @moduledoc """
  Provider-specific adapter for ProCoder LLM interactions.
  Maps internal `ProCoder.Core.Types.Message` to vendor-specific formats and handles
  streaming, error correction, and telemetry.
  """

  @behaviour ProCoder.Brain.Client.Adapter

  require Logger
  alias ProCoder.Core.Types.Message
  alias ProCoder.Brain.Client.HTTPPool.Manager
  alias ProCoder.Brain.Client.SSEParser
  alias ProCoder.Config.Validator

  @impl true
  def chat(context, opts) do
    pool_name = Keyword.get(opts, :pool_name, :default_pool)
    
    with {:ok, pool} <- Manager.checkout(pool_name) do
      payload = format_payload(context)
      headers = [
        {"content-type", "application/json"}, 
        {"authorization", "Bearer " <> get_api_key()}
      ]
      
      request = Finch.build(:post, get_base_url() <> "/chat/completions", headers, Jason.encode!(payload))
      
      case Finch.request(request, pool, receive_timeout: Keyword.get(opts, :timeout, 30_000)) do
        {:ok, %Finch.Response{status: 200, body: body}} ->
          handle_response(body)
        {:ok, %Finch.Response{status: 429}} ->
          {:error, :rate_limited}
        {:error, %{reason: :timeout}} ->
          {:error, :timeout}
        _ ->
          {:error, :malformed_payload}
      end
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def stream(caller, context, opts) do
    pool_name = Keyword.get(opts, :pool_name, :default_pool)
    
    with {:ok, pool} <- Manager.checkout(pool_name) do
      payload = format_payload(context) |> Map.put(:stream, true)
      headers = [
        {"content-type", "application/json"}, 
        {"authorization", "Bearer " <> get_api_key()}
      ]
      
      ref = make_ref()
      
      case SSEParser.start_link(caller: caller, config: ProCoder.Brain.Client.Requirements.stream_config()) do
        {:ok, parser} ->
          request = Finch.build(:post, get_base_url() <> "/chat/completions", headers, Jason.encode!(payload))
          
          spawn_link(fn ->
            Finch.stream(request, pool, nil, fn
              {:status, status}, _ -> {:ok, status}
              {:headers, _}, _ -> {:ok, :headers}
              {:data, data}, _ ->
                SSEParser.process_chunk(parser, data)
                {:ok, :data}
              error, _ ->
                Logger.error("Stream error: #{Validator.redact(inspect(error))}")
                {:ok, :error}
            end)
          end)
          
          {:ok, ref}
        {:error, reason} ->
          {:error, reason}
      end
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def validate_payload(messages) do
    if Enum.all?(messages, &valid_message?/1) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :malformed_payload}
    end
  end

  # --- Internal Helpers ---

  defp format_payload(messages) do
    %{
      model: "procoder-default",
      messages: Enum.map(messages, fn m ->
        %{role: m.role, content: m.content}
      end)
    }
  end

  defp handle_response(body) do
    case Jason.decode(body) do
      {:ok, %{"choices" => [%{"message" => msg}]}} ->
        if valid_tool_calls?(Map.get(msg, "tool_calls")),
          do: {:ok, %Message{role: :assistant, content: msg["content"]}},
          else: {:error, :malformed_payload}
      _ ->
        {:error, :malformed_payload}
    end
  end

  defp valid_tool_calls?(nil), do: true
  defp valid_tool_calls?(calls) when is_list(calls), do: Enum.all?(calls, &is_map/1)
  defp valid_tool_calls?(_), do: false

  defp valid_message?(%Message{role: r}) when r in [:system, :user, :assistant], do: true
  defp valid_message?(_), do: false

  defp get_api_key, do: System.get_env("PROCODER_LLM_API_KEY", "dev_mock_token")
  defp get_base_url, do: System.get_env("PROCODER_LLM_URL", "http://localhost:8080")
end

defmodule ProCoder.Brain.Client.SSEParser do
  @moduledoc """
  High-performance SSE stream parser for LLM token ingestion.

  This module implements a line-buffered state machine for parsing Server-Sent Events (SSE)
  as defined in the HTML5 specification. It extracts data frames, performs hardened JSON
  decoding, and propagates events to the orchestrating GenServer.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  alias ProCoder.Brain.Client.Requirements

  @type state :: %{
    buffer: binary(),
    caller: pid(),
    config: keyword()
  }

  @doc """
  Starts the SSE Parser process.
  """
  def start_link(caller: caller, config: config) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{caller: caller, config: config})
  end

  @impl true
  def init(%{caller: caller, config: config}) do
    {:ok, %{buffer: "", caller: caller, config: config}}
  end

  @doc """
  Processes a raw binary chunk from the network stream.
  """
  def process_chunk(pid, chunk) when is_binary(chunk) do
    GenServer.cast(pid, {:process_chunk, chunk})
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:process_chunk, chunk}, %{buffer: buffer, caller: caller} = state) do
    new_buffer = buffer <> chunk
    
    # Check for SSE delimiter (\n\n)
    case String.split(new_buffer, "\n\n", parts: 2) do
      [frame, rest] ->
        handle_frame(frame, caller)
        {:noreply, %{state | buffer: rest}}

      [_incomplete] ->
        # Enforce buffer limit (back-pressure)
        if byte_size(new_buffer) > Keyword.get(state.config, :max_buffer_size, 10_000) do
          send(caller, {:sse_error, :buffer_overflow})
          {:stop, :buffer_overflow, state}
        else
          {:noreply, %{state | buffer: new_buffer}}
        end
    end
  end

  defp handle_frame(frame, caller) do
    lines = String.split(frame, "\n")
    
    Enum.each(lines, fn line ->
      cond do
        String.starts_with?(line, "data: ") ->
          data = String.replace_prefix(line, "data: ", "")
          parse_data(data, caller)

        String.starts_with?(line, "event: ") ->
          event = String.replace_prefix(line, "event: ", "")
          send(caller, {:sse_event, event})

        line == "" -> :noop
        true -> :noop
      end
    end)
  end

  defp parse_data("[DONE]", caller) do
    send(caller, :sse_done)
  end

  defp parse_data(data, caller) do
    case Requirements.parse_frame(data) do
      {:ok, decoded} ->
        send(caller, {:sse_message, decoded})
      {:error, :malformed_json_frame} ->
        send(caller, {:sse_error, :malformed_json_frame})
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:timeout, state) do
    send(state.caller, {:sse_error, :timeout})
    {:stop, :normal, state}
  end
end
